deployments_detail.use: AI used to accelerate drug pipeline development from formulation through Phase 1 initiation

Data-driven, automation and AI approaches in the BEPO STAR long-acting-injectable formulation platform to accelerate candidate/formulation development ('from idea to clinically ready assets in ~3 years'). Management stated on the May 12, 2026 R&D Day that automation, parallel workflows and data-driven approaches have cut formulation timelines by roughly half. [In-house (BEPO STAR platform)]
R&D Day corporate deck describing 'Acceleration through automation / AI / data-driven approaches' built on BEPO chemistry to reach clinically ready assets faster. [In-house]

CIFRE-funded doctoral research program on 'Modeling the release kinetics of active ingredients from a polymer matrix, predictive models and data mining' - i.e. predictive/ML modeling of drug release to accelerate the drug-candidate portfolio, done with academic partners under France's CIFRE PhD scheme. [In-house + academic (CIFRE program)]

Machine-learning analysis of clinical trial data for UZEDY / TV-46000 (risperidone LAI, RISE study in schizophrenia) - ML applied to symptom-improvement data from patients treated with TV-46000 vs placebo, presented at Psych Congress 2025 by MedinCell/Teva. [MedinCell / Teva (clinical partner)]

Transition to in silico evaluation of depot drug release via complex computational models, being investigated by MedinCell to complement its new flow-through in vitro dissolution apparatus (in vitro-in vivo release prediction for in situ forming depots). [In-house (R&D, under development)]

Use of an AI language model to translate MedinCell's official financial/regulatory documents (Universal Registration Document, half-year financial report) from French into English for investors. [AI language model (unnamed)]

'Responsible use of data & artificial intelligence' identified as a material ESG/governance topic under MedinCell's business-conduct pillar, indicating company-wide AI usage subject to a governance policy. [In-house governance]
